Package kamkeel.npcdbc.api.easing

Interface Easing

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    ConstantEasing, CubicBezier, Linear, LinearPiecewise
    public interface Easing
    Functional interface for easing (timing) functions used in animations and transitions.

    An Easing transforms a normalized time value (progress from 0.0 to 1.0) into an eased output value, allowing control over acceleration, deceleration, bouncing, elasticity, etc.

    This interface matches common easing patterns found in CSS transitions/animations, Unity, Unreal Engine, and other animation systems.

    • Method Detail

      • clamp

        static double clamp​(double t)
        Clamps a time value to the range [0.0, 1.0].

        Values below 0 are clamped to 0, values above 1 are clamped to 1.

        Parameters:
        t - the input time/progress value
        Returns:
        the clamped value in [0.0, 1.0]

        Returns:
